nodes.content: Develop causal speech enhancement that distinguishes whispered consonants from transient noise without fabricating speech during ambiguous acoustic events.
requirements: Improve SI-SDR by ≥3 dB over noisy inputs on held-out whispered speech and unseen noises.
Consonant deletion and insertion rates must not exceed unprocessed-input rates under matched phonetic evaluation.

nodes.content: Train a causal complex-mask enhancer with consonant-versus-impulse discrimination, uncertainty-gated noisy-input bypass, and phonetic insertion/deletion penalties.
How should bypass confidence be calibrated on unseen impulses to protect whispered stops without raising consonant insertion rates?
Calibrating bypass gates to noisy-input stop recall on validation mixtures keeps unseen-impulse insertions and deletions within input baselines.
Calibrate bypass to noisy-input stop recall; measure matched phonetic insertion/deletion rates and SI-SDR on held-out whispered speech with unseen impulses.
On unseen-impulse WhisperImpulse-Holdout, stop-recall-calibrated gating gained 3.4 dB SI-SDR; consonant insertions fell 4.5%→4.1%, deletions 7.8%→7.2% versus input.
Retain stop-recall-calibrated bypass for unseen impulses; its 3.4 dB SI-SDR gain accompanies lower consonant insertion and deletion rates.
Freeze the retained stop-recall-calibrated bypass; benchmark causal latency, SI-SDR, and matched consonant errors across held-out whispers and unseen noise families.
Benchmark retained-gate enhancer on held-out whispers with unseen clicks, babble, and wind; log SI-SDR, matched deletion/insertion rates, and causal latency.
WhisperImpulse-Holdout v1 report contains per-noise SI-SDR gains, matched consonant insertion/deletion rates versus input, and measured streaming latency.
Audit WhisperImpulse-Holdout v1 by replaying streams and recomputing per-noise SI-SDR, matched consonant insertion/deletion rates, and latency.
Replay audit: click/babble/wind SI-SDR gains 3.4/3.2/3.1 dB; matched insertion/deletion rates below input per noise; streaming latency 32 ms.
Spectral-flux-stratified bypass thresholds reduce unseen-impulse insertion rates below 4.1% without exceeding the 7.2% deletion rate.
Fit spectral-flux-stratified bypass thresholds on validation mixtures; compare held-out unseen-impulse consonant insertion/deletion rates and SI-SDR against retained gating.
On WhisperImpulse-Holdout, flux thresholds cut insertions 4.1%→3.6% but raised deletions 7.2%→8.0%, exceeding the 7.8% input baseline.
Can class-conditional phonetic penalties prevent whispered /s/ deletions in wind while retaining at least 3 dB SI-SDR gain?
Train /s/-weighted phonetic-loss variants; benchmark matched wind-whisper /s/ deletions, consonant insertions, and SI-SDR against retained-gate and noisy-input baselines.
Wind-whisper /s/ deletions were 12.4% with retained gating and 10.6% with /s/-weighting, versus 10.1% input; SI-SDR gained 3.1 dB.
Introduce a causal /s/-protection residual gated by multi-band sibilance evidence; bypass uncertain frames instead of reconstructing missing consonants.
Train causal sibilance-gated residuals; compare held-out wind /s/ deletions, consonant insertions, and SI-SDR gain against noisy inputs.
Train causal sibilance-gated residuals; use WhisperImpulse-Holdout v1’s wind SI-SDR and consonant-error baselines to evaluate gains and /s/ deletions.
SibilanceGate-v1 checkpoint adds a causal multi-band /s/-protection residual and uncertain-frame bypass to the retained-gate enhancer.
Evaluate SibilanceGate-v1 on held-out wind whispers: compare /s/ deletions, consonant insertions, and SI-SDR against noisy input and retained gating.
On held-out wind whispers, SibilanceGate-v1 achieved 9.8% /s/ deletions (input: 10.1%), 3.8% consonant insertions (input: 4.5%), and +3.1 dB SI-SDR.
Select SibilanceGate-v1 over /s/-weighted loss: wind /s/ deletions fall below input, with 3.8% insertions and +3.1 dB SI-SDR.
Using WhisperImpulse-Holdout v1 baselines, compare SibilanceGate-v1 with retained gating across clicks, babble, and wind for SI-SDR, consonant errors, and latency.
SibilanceGate-v1 gained 3.3/3.2/3.1 dB across clicks/babble/wind; wind /s/ deletions were 9.8% versus retained-gate 12.4% and input 10.1%.
On unseen hiss bursts, SibilanceGate-v1’s uncertainty bypass keeps /s/ insertions and deletions below noisy-input rates.
Does SibilanceGate-v1 mistake unseen hiss bursts for whispered /s/, causing insertions or masking genuine /s/?
Challenge SibilanceGate-v1 on unseen hiss bursts with and without whispered /s/; compare matched /s/ errors against noisy input.
On unseen hiss bursts, SibilanceGate-v1 /s/ insertions reached 6.4% versus 5.0% input; /s/ deletions were 10.3% versus 11.0%.
Sustained multi-band sibilance and preceding vowel context reduce hiss-burst /s/ insertions below 5.0% without exceeding 11.0% deletions.
Add 80-ms lookback sibilance persistence and preceding-vowel checks to SibilanceGate-v1; retest unseen hiss-burst /s/ errors against input.
On unseen hiss, 80-ms persistence and vowel context reduced /s/ insertions 6.4%→4.7% (input 5.0%); deletions rose 10.3%→10.8% (input 11.0%).
Deploy SibilanceGate-v2 with 80-ms past-only sibilance persistence, preceding-vowel checks, and noisy-input bypass for uncertain transients.
Does SibilanceGate-v2’s preceding-vowel check delete word-initial whispered /s/ under unseen hiss despite reducing burst-triggered insertions?
Under unseen hiss, noisy-input bypass preserves word-initial /s/ lacking vowel context, keeping matched deletions at or below input.
Benchmark e8’s 80-ms gate on word-initial /s/ deletions versus noisy input; retest flux thresholds on unseen-impulse consonant errors.
Hiss: word-initial /s/ deletions 12.6% (input 13.0%); unseen impulses: retuned flux insertions 3.8%, deletions 7.1% under 80-ms gating.
Using e8’s 80-ms gate and e9’s flux thresholds, ablate bypass; compare initial /s/ deletions against input by hiss overlap.
During overlapping hiss, word-initial /s/ deletions reached 17.2% with bypass versus 15.0% input; bypass ablation reached 21.4%.
Exempting word-initial /s/ from vowel checks using 20-ms multi-band evidence should limit overlapping-hiss deletions to ≤15.0% without exceeding 5.0% insertions.
Modify e8’s 80-ms gate with a 20-ms word-initial exemption targeting e10’s overlap failures; measure hiss-overlap /s/ deletions and insertions.
20-ms exemption: overlapping-hiss initial /s/ deletions fell to 14.7% (input 15.0%), but hiss insertions rose to 5.8% (input 5.0%).
Sweep 20-ms word-initial multi-band evidence thresholds on e8’s gate; compare overlapping-hiss /s/ deletions and hiss insertions with e10.
At a stricter 20-ms threshold, overlapping-hiss initial /s/ deletions were 14.9% (input 15.0%); hiss insertions 4.9% (input 5.0%).
Compare e8’s bypass against e12’s strict exemption on disjoint speakers with e10’s overlapping hiss; measure /s/ deletions and insertions.
On disjoint speakers, bypass produced 12.8% initial-/s/ deletions versus 13.0% input overall; strict exemption produced 12.4%.
On disjoint-speaker overlapping hiss, strict exemption caused 16.2% initial-/s/ deletions versus 15.0% input, despite 12.4% overall.
Use causal event-level noisy-input bypass for ambiguous hiss-/s/ overlaps, restricting SibilanceGate enhancement to confidently identified consonant frames.
Can past-only event boundaries trigger bypass before hiss masks word-initial /s/ without sacrificing the 3 dB SI-SDR gain?
A 10-ms past-only onset detector enables event bypass with ≥3 dB SI-SDR gain, ≤15.0% initial-/s/ deletions, and ≤5.0% insertions.
Use exemption-threshold sweeps and disjoint-speaker overall/overlap findings to test 10-ms causal onset bypass for SI-SDR and /s/ errors.
On disjoint-speaker unseen hiss, 10-ms onset bypass gained 3.1 dB SI-SDR; overlapping initial-/s/ deletions were 14.8%, insertions 4.8%.
Given e15’s passing hiss-overlap results, benchmark 10-ms onset bypass on unseen noises for SI-SDR, matched consonant errors, and latency.
Integrate 10-ms onset bypass into SibilanceGate-v1; benchmark unseen clicks, babble, wind, and hiss for SI-SDR, consonant errors, and latency.
OnsetBypass-v1 checkpoint adds 10-ms past-only event gating to SibilanceGate-v1; benchmark bundle contains per-noise SI-SDR, phonetic errors, and latency.
Audit OnsetBypass-v1’s benchmark bundle against noisy inputs, recomputing per-noise SI-SDR, matched consonant errors, and streaming latency.
Audit: clicks/babble/wind/hiss gained 3.3/3.2/3.1/3.1 dB SI-SDR; consonant insertions and deletions stayed below input per noise; latency 32 ms.
Select OnsetBypass-v1: each unseen noise clears +3 dB SI-SDR without exceeding noisy-input consonant errors; streaming latency remains 32 ms.
